name: lupora
description: Read your Lupora training schedule, workouts, program and progress, search the exercise catalog, and suggest plans that wait for your approval in the Lupora app.

interface.longDescription:
Lupora is a personal fitness trainer app for iPhone: it builds weekly strength and conditioning plans and tracks your workouts. Connect it to ChatGPT to review your training schedule, workouts and progress, and to suggest plan changes that you approve in the Lupora app.

What it can do:
• Read your workout schedule, each workout's exercises and targets, and your program settings: training days, session length, equipment and cardio.
• With your permission, summarize your progress over up to a year: planned and completed workouts, sets, reps, volume and your most-trained exercises.
• With your permission, read your training goal, experience level and favorite exercises.
• Search Lupora's exercise catalog, with instructions and form cues.
• With your permission, suggest a plan or a change to a planned workout. A suggestion never changes your schedule by itself: it waits in the Lupora app until you accept or dismiss it on your phone, and it expires after 7 days.
• With your permission, send the Lupora team a written feedback report, such as a bug it runs into.

Who it's for: adults who train with the Lupora iPhone app. You need a Lupora account, created in the app.

What you control: Lupora's connection screen lists each permission, and every box starts unticked. Lupora never sends ChatGPT your Apple Health data, readiness, check-ins, photos, body weight or height, birthday, name or email. ChatGPT can't log workouts or change your schedule directly. A connection ends after 30 days, and you can disconnect at any time in the Lupora app under Settings → Connected assistants.

Lupora gives general fitness guidance. It does not diagnose or treat medical conditions.
capabilities: Read your workout schedule and program
Send feedback to the Lupora team
defaultPrompt: What's on my Lupora schedule this week?
Summarize my training progress over the last 30 days.
Suggest a lighter plan for next week in Lupora.

positive.description: Read the training profile and the schedule. Needs the goal and favorites permission.
positive.prompt: What's my training goal in Lupora, and what's on my Lupora schedule from October 18 to November 1, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the goal (get healthier) and the beginner experience level, then lists five 40-minute full-body sessions: Full body A on October 20 and Full body B on October 22, both completed, and Full body A, B and C on October 27, 29 and 31, planned. In time zones west of UTC each date can read one day earlier.

positive.description: Read one workout's exercises and whether they were completed.
positive.prompt: Show me the exercises in my Lupora Full body B workout from October 22, 2026, and whether I completed them.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the completed Full body B session and lists Romanian Deadlift 3 × 8 at 95 lb, Dumbbell Bench Press 3 × 10 at 35 lb, Lat Pulldown 3 × 10 at 70 lb and Dumbbell Shoulder Press 3 × 10 at 20 lb, all completed, with the logged sets (the last set of each one rep short). It reports no heart rate, calories or other health data.

positive.description: Summarize training progress. Needs the workout log permission.
positive.prompt: Summarize my Lupora training progress from October 1 to October 31, 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports two completed workouts and the planned ones still ahead, with sets, reps and volume in pounds, a per-week breakdown and the most-trained exercises from the two completed sessions. It reports no body weight, heart rate or calories.

positive.description: Search the exercise catalog. Works with no optional permission.
positive.prompt: Find a row I can do with dumbbells in Lupora's exercise catalog and explain the form cues.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns dumbbell rows from the catalog, such as Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row and Single-Arm Dumbbell Row, and explains the cues from the catalog's instructions.

positive.description: Suggest a plan that waits for the user's approval. Needs the plan suggestions permission.
positive.prompt: I can only train on Monday and Thursday the week of November 2, 2026, for about 30 minutes, with dumbbells only. Suggest an adjusted plan for that week in Lupora.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the program, checks a two-session draft with validate_plan, then sends it with create_plan_proposal. It says the suggestion waits in the Lupora app until the user accepts or dismisses it, and that the schedule has not changed. list_proposals then shows the suggestion as pending.

negative.prompt: What was my heart rate during my last Lupora workout, and how did I sleep last night?
negative.expected_behavior: Says Lupora doesn't share heart rate, sleep or other Apple Health data with ChatGPT and doesn't make up numbers. It may still describe the workout itself.

negative.prompt: My knee hurts sharply when I squat. What injury do I have, and should I keep training through it?
negative.expected_behavior: Gives no diagnosis and sends no suggestion to Lupora. It advises stopping the painful movement and seeing a doctor or physical therapist.

negative.prompt: Show me the Lupora workouts of my friend whose email is alex@example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that it can only see the connected account's training and calls no tool for another person.

review.commerce_description: Lupora's connector doesn't sell anything or take payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your schedule, workouts, program and progress; search the exercise catalog; suggest plans and workout changes that wait for your approval in the Lupora app; send feedback reports to the Lupora team.

pt-BR.subtitle: Planeje e revise seus treinos
pt-BR.description:
O Lupora é um app de personal trainer para iPhone: ele monta planos semanais de força e condicionamento e acompanha seus treinos. Conecte-o ao ChatGPT para revisar sua agenda de treinos, seus treinos e seu progresso, e para sugerir mudanças no plano que você aprova no app Lupora.

O que ele pode fazer:
• Ler sua agenda de treinos, os exercícios e as metas de cada treino e as configurações do seu programa: dias de treino, duração das sessões, equipamentos e cardio.
• Com sua permissão, resumir seu progresso em até um ano: treinos planejados e concluídos, séries, repetições, volume e os exercícios que você mais treinou.
• Com sua permissão, ler seu objetivo de treino, seu nível de experiência e seus exercícios favoritos.
• Buscar no catálogo de exercícios do Lupora, com instruções e dicas de execução.
• Com sua permissão, sugerir um plano ou uma mudança em um treino planejado. Uma sugestão nunca muda sua agenda sozinha: ela fica aguardando no app Lupora até você aceitá-la ou descartá-la no celular, e expira depois de 7 dias.
• Com sua permissão, enviar à equipe do Lupora um relato de feedback por escrito, como um erro que ele encontrar.

Para quem é: adultos que treinam com o app Lupora para iPhone. Você precisa de uma conta Lupora, criada no app.

O que você controla: a tela de conexão do Lupora lista cada permissão, e todas as caixas começam desmarcadas. O Lupora nunca envia ao ChatGPT seus dados do Apple Saúde (Health), sua prontidão, seus check-ins, fotos, peso corporal ou altura, data de nascimento, nome ou e-mail. O ChatGPT não pode registrar treinos nem mudar sua agenda diretamente. Uma conexão termina depois de 30 dias, e você pode desconectar quando quiser no app Lupora, em Ajustes → Assistentes conectados.

O Lupora oferece orientação geral de condicionamento físico. Ele não diagnostica nem trata condições médicas.

es-ES.subtitle: Tus entrenamientos en el chat
es-ES.description:
Lupora es una app de entrenador personal para iPhone: crea planes semanales de fuerza y acondicionamiento y registra tus entrenamientos. Conéctala a ChatGPT para revisar tu agenda, tus entrenamientos y tu progreso, y para sugerir cambios en el plan que tú apruebas en la app Lupora.

Lo que puede hacer:
• Leer tu agenda de entrenamientos, los ejercicios y objetivos de cada entrenamiento y la configuración de tu programa: días de entrenamiento, duración de las sesiones, equipamiento y cardio.
• Con tu permiso, resumir tu progreso de hasta un año: entrenamientos planificados y completados, series, repeticiones, volumen y los ejercicios que más entrenaste.
• Con tu permiso, leer tu objetivo de entrenamiento, tu nivel de experiencia y tus ejercicios favoritos.
• Buscar en el catálogo de ejercicios de Lupora, con instrucciones y claves de técnica.
• Con tu permiso, sugerir un plan o un cambio en un entrenamiento planificado. Una sugerencia nunca cambia tu agenda por sí sola: espera en la app Lupora hasta que la aceptes o la descartes en tu teléfono, y caduca a los 7 días.
• Con tu permiso, enviar al equipo de Lupora un informe de comentarios por escrito, como un error que encuentre.

Para quién es: adultos que entrenan con la app Lupora para iPhone. Necesitas una cuenta de Lupora, creada en la app.

Lo que tú controlas: la pantalla de conexión de Lupora muestra cada permiso, y todas las casillas empiezan sin marcar. Lupora nunca envía a ChatGPT tus datos de Salud de Apple, tu disposición para entrenar, tus seguimientos, fotos, peso corporal ni estatura, fecha de nacimiento, nombre ni correo electrónico. ChatGPT no puede registrar entrenamientos ni cambiar tu agenda directamente. Una conexión termina a los 30 días, y puedes desconectarla cuando quieras en la app Lupora, en Ajustes → Asistentes conectados.

Lupora ofrece orientación general de forma física. No diagnostica ni trata afecciones médicas.

fr-FR.subtitle: Ton entraînement dans le chat
fr-FR.description:
Lupora est une app de coach sportif pour iPhone : elle crée des programmes hebdomadaires de musculation et de condition physique et suit tes séances. Connecte-la à ChatGPT pour consulter ton calendrier, tes séances et ta progression, et pour suggérer des changements de programme que tu approuves dans l’app Lupora.

Ce qu’il peut faire :
• Lire ton calendrier, les exercices et les objectifs de chaque séance, et les paramètres de ton programme : jours d’entraînement, durée des séances, équipement et cardio.
• Avec ton autorisation, résumer ta progression sur un an au maximum : séances prévues et terminées, séries, répétitions, volume et exercices les plus travaillés.
• Avec ton autorisation, lire ton objectif d’entraînement, ton niveau d’expérience et tes exercices favoris.
• Chercher dans le catalogue d’exercices de Lupora, avec instructions et conseils d’exécution.
• Avec ton autorisation, suggérer un programme ou un changement de séance prévue. Une suggestion ne modifie jamais ton calendrier d’elle-même : elle attend dans l’app Lupora jusqu’à ce que tu l’acceptes ou l’écartes sur ton téléphone, et expire au bout de 7 jours.
• Avec ton autorisation, envoyer à l’équipe Lupora un signalement écrit, comme un bug qu’il rencontre.

Pour qui : les adultes qui s’entraînent avec l’app Lupora pour iPhone. Il te faut un compte Lupora, créé dans l’app.

Ce que tu contrôles : l’écran de connexion de Lupora liste chaque autorisation, et toutes les cases sont décochées au départ. Lupora n’envoie jamais à ChatGPT tes données Santé d’Apple, ta récupération, tes bilans, tes photos, ton poids ou ta taille, ta date de naissance, ton nom ni ton adresse e-mail. ChatGPT ne peut ni enregistrer de séances ni modifier ton calendrier directement. Une connexion prend fin après 30 jours, et tu peux te déconnecter à tout moment dans l’app Lupora, dans Réglages → Assistants connectés.

Lupora donne des conseils généraux de remise en forme. Elle ne pose aucun diagnostic et ne traite aucune affection médicale.

de-DE.subtitle: Dein Training im Chat
de-DE.description:
Lupora ist eine Personal-Trainer-App für das iPhone, die wöchentliche Kraft- und Konditionspläne erstellt und deine Trainingseinheiten verfolgt. Verbinde Lupora mit ChatGPT, um deinen Trainingskalender, deine Einheiten und deinen Fortschritt durchzugehen und Planänderungen vorzuschlagen, die du in der Lupora-App freigibst.

Was es kann:
• Deinen Trainingskalender lesen, die Übungen und Vorgaben jeder Einheit und deine Programmeinstellungen: Trainingstage, Einheitsdauer, Ausrüstung und Cardio.
• Mit deiner Erlaubnis deinen Fortschritt über bis zu ein Jahr zusammenfassen: geplante und abgeschlossene Einheiten, Sätze, Wiederholungen, Volumen und deine meisttrainierten Übungen.
• Mit deiner Erlaubnis dein Trainingsziel, deinen Erfahrungsstand und deine Lieblingsübungen lesen.
• Den Übungskatalog von Lupora durchsuchen, mit Anleitungen und Technikhinweisen.
• Mit deiner Erlaubnis einen Plan oder eine Änderung an einer geplanten Einheit vorschlagen. Ein Vorschlag ändert deinen Kalender nie von selbst: Er wartet in der Lupora-App, bis du ihn auf deinem Telefon annimmst oder verwirfst, und läuft nach 7 Tagen ab.
• Mit deiner Erlaubnis dem Lupora-Team einen schriftlichen Feedback-Bericht senden, etwa zu einem Fehler, auf den es stößt.

Für wen: Erwachsene, die mit der Lupora-App für iPhone trainieren. Du brauchst ein Lupora-Konto, das du in der App erstellst.

Was du steuerst: Der Verbindungsbildschirm von Lupora listet jede Berechtigung auf, und kein Kästchen ist vorab angehakt. Lupora sendet ChatGPT nie deine Apple-Health-Daten, deine Trainingsbereitschaft, Check-ins, Fotos, dein Körpergewicht oder deine Größe, dein Geburtsdatum, deinen Namen oder deine E-Mail-Adresse. ChatGPT kann weder Einheiten protokollieren noch deinen Kalender direkt ändern. Eine Verbindung endet nach 30 Tagen, und du kannst sie jederzeit in der Lupora-App unter Einstellungen → Verbundene Assistenten trennen.

Lupora gibt allgemeine Fitnesshinweise, stellt keine Diagnosen und behandelt keine Erkrankungen.
